import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Extract systolic blood pressure
df['Systolic BP'] = df['Blood Pressure'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('/')[0]))

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Avg Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.1f')

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Physical Activity Level'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                      s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Physical Activity')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(bmi_counts))
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 4. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Sleep Disorder
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax4.scatter(subset['Daily Steps'], subset['Heart Rate'], 
                label=disorder, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax4.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate')
ax4.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')

# 5. Physical Activity Level by BMI Category
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
existing_bmi = [b for b in bmi_order if b in df['BMI Category'].values]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Physical Activity Level', 
            ax=ax5, palette='coolwarm', order=existing_bmi)
ax5.set_title('Physical Activity by BMI Category')
ax5.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax5.set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level')

# 6. Blood Pressure vs Sleep Quality
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
colors_bp = ['red' if d == 'Sleep Apnea' else 'green' for d in df['Sleep Disorder']]
ax6.scatter(df['Systolic BP'], df['Quality of Sleep'], c=colors_bp, 
            s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Systolic Blood Pressure')
ax6.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax6.set_title('Blood Pressure vs Sleep Quality')
# Custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='green', label='No Disorder'),
                   Patch(facecolor='red', label='Sleep Apnea')]
ax6.legend(handles=legend_elements)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
